about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Stack, experience and focus areas
about.bio: Fullstack developer with 4+ years of experience building, scaling, and maintaining web and mobile applications for international markets. I specialize in the MERN stack, React Native, and scalable backend architecture. Deep expertise in Next.js for high-load frontends and NestJS for structured services. For over 2 years I've mentored junior engineers in system design, application architecture, and engineering best practices.

approach.title: How I work
approach.subtitle: Approach to tasks and AI tools

items.title: Understand the problem
items.text: I clarify business goals, constraints, and definition of done first. Work is decomposed into iterations with measurable outcomes.

items.title: Architecture and quality
items.text: API and UI are designed for scale, typing, and testability. Code review, linters, and shared patterns are part of every delivery.

items.title: Ship fast
items.text: MVP-first mindset: a working end-to-end flow first, then performance and UX improvements.

aiItems: At daytwo.ai I integrated LLM APIs into a production platform: prompt design, error handling, rate limits, and monitoring.
Day to day I use Cursor and Copilot for boilerplate, refactors, and docs; I always review the final code manually.
When mentoring, I show how AI speeds up learning without replacing architecture understanding and debugging skills.

bullets: Built and maintained production-grade apps with Next.js, Node.js, Express, and Supabase.
Integrated AI/LLM APIs into the web platform.
Worked in a distributed team on rapid prototyping and MVP releases.
Taught backend development through hands-on projects and mentorship.
Designed a curriculum that helped 90% of students significantly improve their technical level.
Trained 200+ students in MERN and React Native with practical project mentoring.
Led programming skill sessions; 90% of students reported major professional growth.
Built scalable web and mobile products serving thousands of active users.
Introduced secure data practices and optimized system performance.
Designed client-side architecture focused on performance and data security.
Improved UI/UX and fixed critical bugs — 15% increase in user engagement.
Created and optimized mobile and web apps in close collaboration with cross-functional teams.
